correctness.rationale: Maximal-ideal membership gives adjacency exactly; CRT realizes forcing vertices and exclusive cells. Necessity and sufficiency of meeting every T_i are proved, yielding gamma_t=n. Paired domination follows by parity and explicit matchings; the polynomial follows from the complete set classification.

evidence: Mehdi-Nezhad--Rahimi (2015) construct a size-n clique and explicitly say it is connected and total dominating, but only derive ordinary-domination bounds.
Gadge--Khandekar--Joshi (2024) represent Artinian comaximal graphs through Boolean blow-ups and study perfectness/Hamiltonicity.
Rather (2026) studies independent domination and independence polynomials of full comaximal graphs, not total/paired domination of CG_J.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The strongest structural source is compatible with the proof but does not provide the extremal lower bound, set classification, generating function, or paired parameter; the 2015 source leaves exactly the total-minimum question open in practice.

evidence: Remark 3.9 of the 2015 paper establishes an upper total-dominating construction but no matching lower bound.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The final claim is not a special case of a prior domination formula; a new forcing argument from singleton-support vertices is required to prove minimality and classify all total dominating sets.
